clips.title: The story
paras: After the harpies are driven back, Arynia Cloudsbreak sends you with a report to Darnassus. The inscribed bark tells Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm about the boughs and the corruption still troubling the World Tree.

Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak entrusts you with a piece of inscribed bark after you clear the harpies from their nests in the Oracle Glade. The Oracle Tree watches over the forest, and with the harpies gone, Arynia can send word to the kaldorei leadership. You carry her report through the wilderness to Darnassus, the great forest of stone, and deliver it to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm.

Fandral Staghelm receives the report with mixed feelings. He is grateful to hear that the harpies have been pushed back, but the report shows how one threat gives way to another across Teldrassil. Staghelm championed the planting of the new World Tree to reclaim the night elves' lost immortality. The afflictions in its boughs remind him that his work remains far from finished.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The forest whispers of your feats of valor, friend. As I felt the harpies forced from their nests, a greater calm spread across the forest, its creatures once again feeling safe. I have feared sending another messenger to the Arch Druid, but I know that you will see my message safely to him.
Deliver this to him and know that the forest will see you safely along its paths to the forest of stone.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, adventurer. What business do you have with the Arch Druid of the Kaldorei?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I wondered why the Oracle Tree had not communicated with me for so long... It seems that some problems are lessened while others grow to greater concerns.
I fear my work on Teldrassil shall never be completed, and our immortality never restored.
Nonetheless, you have done the Oracle Tree's task well, and should be rewarded for your diligence.
